\input{tikz/fig_header.tex}

% What the exact quantization error really is. The lecture's formula
%
%   e_n(t) = sum_p A_p sin(p w t),
%   A_p = delta_p1 2^(n-1) + sum_m (2/(m pi)) J_p(2 m pi 2^(n-1)),  p odd
%
% says the error is not white noise but a set of ODD harmonics of the
% input, with amplitudes made of Bessel functions. Left: a 3 bit
% quantizer following one period of a sine, and the error it leaves.
% Right: the harmonic amplitudes A_p from that formula (they match a
% direct simulation to about 0.1 percent), against the flat floor the
% Delta^2/12 white noise model would predict.
